'''Sathra-Kan''' was a male [[Voss (species)|Voss]] commando living on [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he asked an outsider to destroy the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] threatening the path to the [[Shrine of Healing]] and report to [[Velan-Raz]].
